column3: Repeats the focus's full شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ warning after a communal-fitnah boundary.
Sets the nearby boundary of حلال/تحريم and اعتداء within the linked pericope.
Places غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا after a detailed binding boundary and its stated exception.
Joins غافر الذنب and قابل التوب with شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ in one attribute sequence.
Adds the immediate حلالًا طيبًا and تقوى setting before the focus.
Connects شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ to مشاقة الله ورسوله.
Adds that Allah knows سرهم ونجواهم, without the focus's paired attributes.
Supplies a differentiated مؤاخذة and كفارة structure inside the same legal sequence.
Pairs forgiveness for those who تابوا with protection from عذاب الجحيم.
Keeps سريع العقاب and غفور رحيم together across an extended historical consequence.
Introduces the prohibited practice whose boundary the following pericope develops.
Connects divine taking after rejected بينات with قوي شديد العقاب.
Locates شديد العذاب in the exposure of misplaced attachments and divine power.
Shows the social and devotional damage attached to the preceding prohibition.
Sets a conditional contrast between gratitude and a declared عذاب شديد.
Isolates فضل and رحمة as a restraint within a communal-accountability setting.
Adds obedience, warning, and messengerly بلاغ, but not the paired attributes.
Links turning and استغفار to the same غفور رحيم closure.
Expands غفور رحيم through distinct acts of عفو, صفح, and مغفرة.
Qualifies earlier conduct through recurring تقوى, إيمان, and إحسان.
Adds a grateful settlement ending in غفور, without the punitive pole.
Frames the غفور رحيم closure after the distinction between claim, faith, and obedience.
Adds a test-boundary where اعتداء after it brings عذاب أليم.
Provides العزيز الغفار in a creation passage, only a remote attribute parallel.
Places the exact شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ formula at the close of ritual limits.
Gives a close legal instance of consequence, عفا عما سلف, and recurrence.
Pairs angelic استغفار with الغفور الرحيم in a cosmic setting.
Combines sacred limits, prohibition of اعتداء, تقوى, and شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ.
Continues the same hunting boundary with prohibition, تقوى, and حشر.
Holds الغفور ذو الرحمة beside deferred rather than erased عذاب.
Places غفور رحيم after enumerated limits and an اضطرار exception.
Adds the immediately preceding knowledge frame, not the attribute pair itself.
Relates مغفرة to recompense for faith and righteous action.
Shares ٱعْلَمُوا۟ but develops a different declaration.
Adds messengerly بلاغ and divine knowledge of disclosed and concealed acts.
Its isolated mercy reference does not develop the focus's punitive-forgiving pairing.
Ends a detailed legal concession with غفور رحيم.
Extends the local boundary sequence through خبيث/طيب and تقوى.
Shows deferred intercessory استغفار ending in الغفور الرحيم.
Places عفا الله عنها and غفور حليم amid limits on inquiry.
Its prior-community outcome is only indirectly related through the linked pericope.
The terse عُقْبَى reference supplies no clear route to either focus attribute.
Explicitly juxtaposes عذاب شديد with مغفرة من الله and رضوان.
Corrects fabricated restrictions in the pericope that culminates in the focus.
Makes استغفار an immediate response within a judgment-related passage.
Gives the nearby repentance-before-capture exception and غفور رحيم closure.
Adds refusal of revealed guidance, with no direct attribute or consequence link.
Keeps اغفر وارحم together in a direct supplicatory form.
Connects ending hostility with the غفور رحيم formula.
Adds personal responsibility and final return, without the focus attributes.
Connects a changed divine favor to شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ.
Pairs acceptance of توبة with التواب الرحيم.
Adds oath-bound testimony and hidden wrongdoing within the local accountability sequence.
Invokes رحمة with guidance in a setting distant from the focus's consequence pole.
Repeats شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ after مشاقة الله ورسوله.
Supplies a corrective witness procedure but no direct focus attribute.
Uses forgiveness and mercy to hold a fractured kinship situation together.
Pairs حلالًا طيبًا and تقوى with غفور رحيم.
Adds oath-accountability and تقوى but no direct focus attribute.
Provides only the divine name ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ.
Ends a shared ritual movement with استغفار and غفور رحيم.
Characterizes divine taking of unjust towns as أليم شديد.
Shares ٱعْلَمُوا۟ but directs it to fitnah and reward rather than the attribute pair.
Pairs الغفور with الودود, enriching only the restorative side.
Uses the غفور رحيم pair in an afterlife reception setting.
Places يغفر and يعذب under divine ownership, then closes غفور رحيم.
Relates denial of divine favor without a direct focus-attribute link.
Contrasts hastening سيئة with seeking forgiveness for mercy.
Shares ٱعْلَمُوا۟ but names العزيز الحكيم rather than the focus pairing.
Links self-acknowledged ظلم, forgiveness, and الغفور الرحيم.
Places human inability to count نعمة before غفور رحيم.
Combines uprightness and استغفار, without the punitive pole.
Gives repentance and إصلاح after ظلم, ending غفور رحيم.
Supplies a lasting consequence for broken promise, but not the focus attributes.
Makes broad forgiveness and رحمة explicit in an address to those who أسرفوا.
Creational انتظام under ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ does not clarify the focus's pairing.
The lexical شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ is a different attribute construction.
Directly announces أنا الغفور الرحيم, strengthening the restorative pole.
Connects denial, sins, divine taking, and شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ.
Uses البر الرحيم as retrospective praise, without the focus's balance.
Connects denial, sins, taking, and قوي شديد العقاب.
Places later توبة under غفور رحيم.
Combines changed enmity with divine قدرة and غفور رحيم.
The lexical ٱشْدُدْ has no clear attribute-level connection to the focus.
Explicitly holds سريع العقاب with غفور رحيم after a test of entrusted gifts.
Adds repentance, إصلاح, and بيان before التواب الرحيم.
Links charitable approach and entry into رحمة, but only indirectly to the focus.
Adds غضب and عذاب شديد in a disputation context.
Connects following the messenger with forgiveness of sins and غفور رحيم.
Joins seeking forgiveness with being shielded from عذاب النار.
Its reward-and-power closure has no direct route to the focus pair.
Places forgiveness and punishment under divine dominion, ending غفورًا رحيمًا.
Supplies تقوى and obedience only.
Presents a temporal mercy-and-promise boundary, not the focus attributes.
States the certainty of دين without developing the focus pairing.
Shows a specific mercy setting but no consequence or forgiveness link.
The watchfulness formula supplies only a broad accountability background.
Gives mercy and enduring honorable mention, remote from the focus balance.
Provides a prohibition consequence for wrongdoing, but no attribute pairing.
Closes an accusation-and-witnessing passage with الغفور الرحيم.
Places ذو رحمة واسعة beside an unaverted بأس for القوم المجرمين.
Holds مغفرة للناس على ظلمهم and شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ in the same declaration.
Supplies the adjoining punitive pole to 15:49: عذابي هو العذاب الأليم.
States a contrary boundary for مغفرة, preserving a limit on the restorative reading.
Directly holds تعذبهم and تغفر لهم in an address to divine judgment.
Links doing سوء or ظلم النفس to finding Allah غفورًا رحيمًا.
Gives a mercy decree, then سوء, توبة, إصلاح, and غفور رحيم.
Places working سيئات, then توبة and إيمان, before غفور رحيم.
Provides a contrary non-forgiveness boundary for a named hypocritical condition.
Repeats the sequence سوء بجهالة, توبة, إصلاح, and غفور رحيم.
Makes المغفرة explicit for the sequence توبة, إيمان, عمل صالح, and اهتداء.
Gives a legal accusation boundary followed by توبة, إصلاح, and غفور رحيم.
Extends توبة, إيمان, and عمل صالح to a transformed سيئات outcome under غفور رحيم.
Pairs acceptance of توبة with عفو عن السيئات.
Names واسع المغفرة while retaining an accountability setting.
Calls for توبة نصوحًا in a passage that sets a future punitive boundary.
Makes استغفار address the attribute غفار directly.
Closes a mitigated obligation with غفور رحيم.
